On each V=l slice, Fresnel linearisation of gamma Z^2 and hyperplane Fourier inversion produce a translated two-dimensional original-coordinate product Fourier integral. Translation-invariant geometric Brascamp-Lieb plus the pinned Lp Fourier lemma bounds it by (4pi)^2, giving |muhat_l(t)|<=4sqrt(pi)|gamma t|^-1/2 and mu_l(I)<=C_*|gamma|^-1/2|I|^1/2 with C_*=13.818801475690845. The account03/B05 single-hub receiver then yields essential density <55.776. Combined with the completed nested-heavy pivot/pair exit, every exact-rank-three heavy physical null-pivot branch is paid.
